title: resourceCpu
responsibility: Converts host and quota counter intervals into currently available cores, respecting affinity and quota saturation.

inputs.name: resourceCpu.previous
inputs.description: Previous CPU interval counters, quota usage and monotonic timestamp.

inputs.name: resourceCpu.current
inputs.description: Current CPU interval counters, affinity, quota usage and monotonic timestamp.

outputs.name: hostCpuCounters
outputs.description: Monotonic host CPU counters, affinity and current cgroup limits for interval comparison.

outputs.name: resourceCpu
outputs.description: Logical and usable cores, observed host utilization and currently available quota-aware cores.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Invalid counter intervals or changed or malformed quota counters require a fresh sample.
